title: Fastned: Tesla Model 3 charge curves (Long Range 2019-2023, Standard Range 2020-2023)
notes: Fastned publishes per-car charge curves measured on its own European CCS2 network (300 kW chargers); the numbers are embedded in the page (kW at each whole SoC %). Page says curves show behaviour with a battery at about 30 C; colder/warmer packs charge slower. CCS2, not Tesla Supercharger, so the peak is capped below the car's Supercharger peak. Fastned Terms of Use (en-gb terms-conditions) are readable and have no clause on reuse of site data; robots.txt allows crawling; no licence for the charge graphs either way, so the owner confirms.
